reservation_binding.substitution: DENY unless an explicit authenticated recovery/migration protocol proves equivalence

root_proof_binding.future_requirement: accepted proof binds logical operation identity or authenticated equivalent
root_proof_binding.after_PREPARED_substitution: DENY unless exact authorized replacement protocol
root_proof_binding.final_closure: operation identity + canonical request + reservation + candidate account_id + accepted proof/validation evidence + COMMITTED genesis
root_proof_binding.exact_proof_model_substitution: proof_A -> proof_B is request mismatch/substitution; DENY unless exact authorized replacement protocol

retry_matrix.case: same operation ID + same request + NEW_OR_UNOBSERVED
retry_matrix.outcome: AUTHORITY_PROOF_REQUIRED; do not infer issuance, reservation, progression, or a new account

retry_matrix.case: same operation ID + same request + RESERVED
retry_matrix.outcome: RECOVER_SAME_OPERATION_AND_CONTINUE_OR_RETURN_TERMINAL_OUTCOME; recover same reservation/account_id/request; may execute only not-yet-durable authorized transition work toward PREPARED; never reallocate or infer account genuineness

retry_matrix.case: same operation ID + same request + PREPARED
retry_matrix.outcome: RECOVER_SAME_OPERATION_AND_CONTINUE_OR_RETURN_TERMINAL_OUTCOME; resume/reconcile same reservation/account_id/request toward same terminal decision; may execute only not-yet-durable authorized transition work; no replacement or second genesis

retry_matrix.case: same operation ID + same request + COMMITTED
retry_matrix.outcome: RETURN_SAME_COMMITTED_OUTCOME; NO_NEW_SIDE_EFFECTS; no new genesis, proof consumption, reservation, or account

retry_matrix.case: same operation ID + same request + ABORTED
retry_matrix.outcome: RETURN_SAME_ABORTED_OUTCOME; NO_NEW_SIDE_EFFECTS; no restart whether reservation is ABORTED_HELD or RELEASED_TOMBSTONED
CONFLICT / CONTRACT_INCONSISTENT; NO_MUTATION at every durable state
UNKNOWN / AUTHORITY_PROOF_REQUIRED; neither duplicate nor independent by ID alone
FAIL_CLOSED unless authority-bound reservation recovery identity deterministically recovers same operation

retry_matrix.case: caller supplies new command ID after crash
retry_matrix.outcome: FAIL_CLOSED; command ID cannot establish a new logical genesis

retry_matrix.case: reservation exists but operation identity missing
retry_matrix.outcome: FAIL_CLOSED unless frozen authenticated deterministic handoff recovers same operation

retry_matrix.case: root proof same but operation IDs differ
retry_matrix.outcome: UNKNOWN / AUTHORITY_PROOF_REQUIRED; proof ID/cardinality/consumption do not prove operation identity

crash_recovery.PREPARED_R1_retry_R2: CONFLICT / CONTRACT_INCONSISTENT even with fresh caller command_id

concurrency.same_request_two_callers: NOT_FROZEN: same operation, two operations, or conflict depends on genuine issuance/idempotency protocol

abort_release.ABORTED: terminal; retains operation identity, canonical request, reservation history and accepted root-proof provenance
abort_release.RELEASE: reservation-only; MUST NOT erase operation/request identity
